units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 9b:1">B. Bath. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ גדול</he> sum total.
Ib. 78ᵇ (play on Ḥeshbon, Num. XXI, 27; 30) באו ונחשב חֶשְׁבּוֹנוֹ וכ׳ come and let us examine the account of the world (human affairs), the loss etc.
<cite ref="Numbers 21:30">Ib.</cite> <he>אבד ח׳ וכ׳</he> the accountability of the world is gone (there is no reward or punishment).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 51:6">Ex. R. s. 51</cite>, beg., a. fr. <he>ליתן ח׳</he> to render an account.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 10:21">Tosef. B. Kam. X, 21</cite> <he>מה ח׳ עשה וכ׳</he> how our father settled with yon; Y. ib. X, 7ᵇ bot.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:8:11">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 42ᵃ</cite> top <he>ח׳ מים וכ׳</he> he understands the calculation of the action of the water.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:8:11">Ib.</cite> <he>ח׳ גדול הוא</he> this is a great thing to calculate; a. fr.

Deut. R. s. 4 איני מכיר חֶשְׁבּוֹנְךָ I do not know your way of settling (whether you are prompt); ib. עשית לי ח׳ טוב you paid me promptly. [Yalk. Deut. 808 הח׳ read בעל הח׳ market commissioner.]—Pl. חֶשְׁבּוֹנוֹת.
